releaseNotes:
1. Restored Hardware & Peripherals Settings: Full configuration controls for RS-232 Digital Scale (Baud rate, COM port, live streaming readout), Receipt Printer driver selector, and Barcode Scanner.
2. Streamlined Printer Setup: Installed Windows printer driver selection with one-click refresh.
3. Header Minimalist Display: Only Digital Scale live weight displayed in top header.
4. Robust In-App Update Relaunch: Detached background script safely replaces files and restarts Plannest POS without white screen hangs.
